title: Home Oxygen Therapy Hospice Liaison Note — The Day the Need for Oxygen Ended
content:
# The Day the Need for Oxygen Ended — Home Oxygen Therapy

**Rule.** When Home Oxygen Therapy equipment that is no longer needed is returned, the oxygen record closes on the day the need ended. The day the need ended is read from the patient's records:

1. when the patient's Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces bed rental is active and shows a hospice election dated before the confirmation, it is that hospice election date;
2. otherwise, when the oxygen record is suspended, it is the suspension date;
3. otherwise it is the day the return is confirmed.

## Records read

| Record | Item |
|---|---|
| the patient's Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces bed rental | whether it is an active rental, and its hospice election date |
| the oxygen record | whether it is suspended, and its suspension date |

## Judgement table

| Bed rental active with a hospice election dated before the confirmation | Oxygen record suspended | Day the need ended |
|---|---|---|
| yes | either | the hospice election date |
| no | yes | the oxygen suspension date |
| no | no | the day the return is confirmed |

A hospice election on a bed rental that is not active, or one dated on or after the day of confirmation, does not supply the day; the oxygen record is then read.

## Cases (hypothetical dates, confirmation on 12 August)

- Bed rental active, hospice election dated 28 July: the need ended on 28 July.
- No active bed rental; oxygen record suspended from 2 August: the need ended on 2 August.
- No active bed rental, oxygen record an active rental: the need ends on 12 August, the day the return is confirmed.
